Heard both sides.
2. Appellants are challenging common judgment and award dated 18.11.2015 passed in Reference Petitions filed by the appellants for enhancement.
They are claiming enhancement of the compensation and the benefit of escalation on the ground of parity.
For that purpose, reliance is placed on consistent view being taken by this Court in numerous matters.
One such elaborate judgment is passed in the matter of Pralhad Annasaheb Nirwal vs. State of Maharashtra and others in First Appeal No.1778 of 2024 with connected matters on 11.12.2025.

Appellants have failed to make a case for enhancement and the appeal is liable to be rejected.
4. Though notice is served upon the respondent acquiring  3 fa st 13402.21 body, nobody appears for the acquiring body.
5. In the present cases, the lands from village Digras have been acquired for 'Nimna Dudhana Project'.
The lands have been classified as dry lands.
The classification has not been disputed by both the parties.
The notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act was issued on 24.11.2005 which is relevant for determining the escalation.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Appellants have failed to make a case for enhancement and the appeal is liable to be rejected.
Appellants are entitled to receive rate of Rs. 2,500/- per Are for dry land, and escalation for 09 years 07 month and 24 days at the rate of 10% per annum.
The payment of interest shall be governed by the decision of the Full Bench of this Court in the matter of State of Maharashtra Vs. Kailash Shiva Rangari reported in [2016 AIR (Bom.)141].
8.
I, therefore, pass following order :
 ORDER a. First Appeal is allowed partly.
b. The appellants shall be entitled to receive rate of Rs.
6,273/- per Are for dry lands.
c. The appellants shall not be entitled to the interest and statutory benefits for the delayed period.
The appellants shall be entitled to the interest under Section 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as per Full Bench judgment in the matter of State of Maharashtra Vs. Kailash Shiva Rangari (supra).
5 fa st 13402.21 e.
Save and except above modification, the impugned judgment and award shall stand unaltered.
f. The appellants shall pay deficit court fees.
g. Award be drawn accordingly.
